title: ocimum selloi var. genuinum
intro: Ocimum selloi var. genuinum, commonly known as Mexican basil, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and act as an antimicrobial agent, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Ocimum selloi var. genuinum include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, such as limonene, linalool, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
